# Proverbs 30 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 30:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Do-not-add to-His-words, lest He-rebuke-you and-you-be-found-a-liar. |
| LOGOS | Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke you and you be found a liar. |
| PNEUMA | Don't add anything to what He's said, or He'll call you out — and you'll be exposed as a liar. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 30:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Vanity and-a-word-of falsehood put-far from-me; poverty and-riches do-not-give-me — feed-me [with]-bread-of my-portion, |
| LOGOS | Remove far from me falsehood and lying; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food that is needful for me, |
| PNEUMA | Keep lies and dishonesty far away from me. And don't make me rich or poor — just give me what I need day by day, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
